notes: v10.4 BUILD REFRESH (2026-09-04, b2962 - the tuned-binary batch, notarized): Five fixes ride this build: 1. A half-spoken last word is never guessed into a full one: when the recording cannot prove how the word ended, the fragment is dropped with the stumble cleaner on and kept exactly as heard with it off — never the engine's guess. 2. The paste card stops trusting an app's wrapper element as proof that text landed and remembers per app when its reading is blind, so the card fires less often and only when the paste truly could not be verified. 3. Phantom words at the end of a dictation — the engine's own weak guesses tied on one instant over silence — are refused before they reach the text (measured at 6 of 6 catches and 0 of 320 false alarms). 4. A long recording that produced nothing lands in History held, with its audio kept and a "Transcribe as…" action that re-transcribes it in the language you choose. 5. Diagnostics keep three generations of the debug log
